description: This Java class defines a REST controller named CheckoutController for handling checkout-related HTTP API endpoints in a shopping application. It provides an endpoint to create an order from cart items, orchestrating the process via a flow component, and returning a structured response with order details.

classes.name: CheckoutController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller handling checkout operations, specifically creating an order from cart items, with dependencies injected via constructor.

methods.name: createOrderFromCart
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create an order from cart data, calling the flow component and returning a detailed checkout response.
